THE DOMAIN
Commodity trading in plain language
A business buys and sells goods such as cocoa, coffee, grain or fuel while market prices change.
textPreview: A business buys and sells goods such as cocoa, coffee, grain or fuel while market prices change.

text: One deal
A batch may be bought once and sold through several orders over time.
textPreview: A batch may be bought once and sold through several orders over time.

text: One position
The unsold or uncovered quantity remains exposed to price changes.
textPreview: The unsold or uncovered quantity remains exposed to price changes.

text: One result
The business needs profit or loss for the sold part and the open part.
textPreview: The business needs profit or loss for the sold part and the open part.

text: Example: buy 100 units, sell 40, manage the remaining 60.
textPreview: Example: buy 100 units, sell 40, manage the remaining 60.

text: General domain explanation. “Position” is the quantity still exposed after purchase and sale activity.

What standard Odoo already provides
The case for this module depends on being precise about the starting point.

text: Orders and stock
Purchase, Sales and Inventory record transactions and physical movement.
textPreview: Purchase, Sales and Inventory record transactions and physical movement.

text: Analytic accounts
They group attributed accounting costs and revenue for profitability analysis.
textPreview: They group attributed accounting costs and revenue for profitability analysis.

text: The missing view
Neither produces this module’s live, trade-specific position from linked orders.
textPreview: Neither produces this module’s live, trade-specific position from linked orders.

THE PRODUCT
The Trade is the connecting record
textPreview: The Trade is the connecting record

text: Users continue to confirm normal Odoo documents. The module builds and updates the Trade from those events.
textPreview: Users continue to confirm normal Odoo documents. The module builds and updates the Trade from those events.

text: Orders
Purchase confirmation creates or updates a long Trade. Sale confirmation links a Trade or creates a short Trade.
textPreview: Purchase confirmation creates or updates a long Trade. Sale confirmation links a Trade or creates a short Trade.

text: Accounting
Invoices and bills connect to the Trade and affect additional cost or revenue.
textPreview: Invoices and bills connect to the Trade and affect additional cost or revenue.

text: Inventory
Validated receipts connect stock lots to the Trade.
textPreview: Validated receipts connect stock lots to the Trade.

text: No second manual entry is required in the normal flow.
textPreview: No second manual entry is required in the normal flow.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, sections 1, 3 and 4.
TRADE LIFECYCLE
Long and short positions
The opening document determines the direction of the position.
textPreview: The opening document determines the direction of the position.

text: Long trade
Buy first. Open quantity is purchase quantity less confirmed sold quantity.
textPreview: Buy first. Open quantity is purchase quantity less confirmed sold quantity.

text: Short trade
Sell first when no matching open Trade exists. The open quantity is negative until covered.
textPreview: Sell first when no matching open Trade exists. The open quantity is negative until covered.

text: A confirmed Trade closes automatically when its matching rule is satisfied.
textPreview: A confirmed Trade closes automatically when its matching rule is satisfied.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, sections 4 to 6. Long close requires matched purchase and sale quantities. A short without a purchase leg uses its separate fully-sold rule.
CORE CALCULATIONS
The numbers on a Trade
Each measure answers a different business question.
textPreview: Each measure answers a different business question.

text: Open position
How much commercial exposure remains.
Realized P&L
Profit or loss on the matched quantity already bought and sold.
textPreview: Profit or loss on the matched quantity already bought and sold.

text: Unrealized P&L
Estimated result on the open quantity using a market price.
textPreview: Estimated result on the open quantity using a market price.

text: Total P&L
Realized plus unrealized P&L, plus additional revenue.
textPreview: Realized plus unrealized P&L, plus additional revenue.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, sections 5 and 6. Market price is entered by a user.
WORKED EXAMPLE
A partial long trade
Illustrative example in one reporting currency, with no extra costs.
textPreview: Illustrative example in one reporting currency, with no extra costs.

text: Buy
100 units × 10 = 1,000 purchase cost.
Sell
40 units × 14 = 560 sales value.
Realized profit
At a market price of 12, open profit is 60 × (12 − 10) = 120. Total P&L is 280.
textPreview: At a market price of 12, open profit is 60 × (12 − 10) = 120. Total P&L is 280.

text: Illustrative arithmetic only. Formula basis: ele_trading README, section 6. Assumes no additional cost or revenue.
FINANCIAL ACCURACY
Currency and invoice lifecycle
The module keeps financial changes tied to the documents that caused them.
textPreview: The module keeps financial changes tied to the documents that caused them.

text: Transaction-date FX
Each transaction converts at the rate from its own date. Mixed-currency sales blend in the reporting currency.
textPreview: Each transaction converts at the rate from its own date. Mixed-currency sales blend in the reporting currency.

text: Additional amounts
Linked bills and invoices add cost or revenue beyond the original order values.
textPreview: Linked bills and invoices add cost or revenue beyond the original order values.

text: Resetting or unlinking a linked invoice reverses its recorded contribution.
textPreview: Resetting or unlinking a linked invoice reverses its recorded contribution.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, sections 4, 6 and 7. A narrow direct-vendor-bill reversal gap remains and is disclosed later.

FOR THE TECH TEAM
How it is wired into Odoo

text: The core model is trading.trade; existing Odoo models gain a Trade link and lifecycle hooks.

text: Order hooks
purchase.order.button_confirm and sale.order.action_confirm create or link Trades.

text: Accounting hooks
account.move posting, draft reset and unlink manage financial contributions.
textPreview: account.move posting, draft reset and unlink manage financial contributions.

text: Stock hook
stock.picking validation links lots and updates physical quantity.
